_info: English texts of the accessories catalogue — overlay to dane/akcesoria.json (same ids). Categories: [name, description]; types ("category/type"): [name, description, manufacturers].

zawiasy: Hinges decide how cabinet doors open: closing softly, opening wide in a corner, without blocking inner drawers, completely invisibly, or with the front sliding away into the side of the cabinet.
bez-uchwytow: Handle-free fronts open with a push, with a light touch assisted by a small motor, or through a finger recess in an aluminium profile. The furniture looks calmer and is easier to keep clean.
szuflady: Drawer systems differ in side thickness and shape, height and finish. Each can have soft-close or push-to-open (see “Drawers — options”).
szuflady-opcje: Extras that suit any drawer system: opening method, soft-close, heights and interior organisation.
podnosniki: Lift systems raise the fronts of wall cabinets upwards instead of swinging them sideways. The type of movement is chosen to match the front size and cabinet height.
cargo: Pull-out baskets and shelves use every centimetre of the cabinet — from narrow spice pull-outs to tall larders and waste sorting under the sink.
narozniki: The corner is the hardest place in a kitchen. These fittings bring the contents out of the depth of the cabinet to you.
cokoly: The space behind the plinth under base cabinets usually goes to waste — it can hold a flat drawer or a pull-out step.
windy: Mechanisms that bring the contents of a cabinet to a comfortable height or pull an extra worktop out of it.
gniazdka: Power where you need it — without sockets on show or cables on the worktop.
led: Light inside furniture: above the worktop, on shelves, in display cabinets and inside drawers and wardrobes.
garderoba: Fittings and accessories that organise a wardrobe or walk-in closet: rails, pull-out hangers, drawer inserts, shoe racks, laundry baskets, mirrors, display fronts and lighting.
drzwi: Door systems for wardrobes and built-in alcoves that need no space for a swinging door.
sprytne: A selection of interesting and new solutions — including unbranded products from China. We show them as inspiration; before installation we check availability and compliance with standards (CE).

zawiasy/standardowy: A standard concealed cup hinge for cabinet doors with a built-in damper — the door closes by itself, quietly and gently, however hard it is pushed. Available in full overlay, half overlay and inset versions.
zawiasy/170: 170°/175° hinge for corner cabinets + bi-fold hinge

A wide-angle hinge (approx. 170°) opens a corner cabinet door to its full width, so the interior is freely accessible. In corner units with folding doors, an additional hinge connects the two door leaves.
Blum (CLIP top 170° + bi-fold door hinge), Hettich, GTV
zawiasy/uskok: Zero-protrusion hinge (approx. 155°) for cabinets with inner drawers

When open, neither the front nor the hinge protrudes into the cabinet opening, so inner drawers behind the door slide out without being blocked. Opening angle approx. 155°; a 125° version for thick fronts.
Blum (CLIP top BLUMOTION 155° / 125° zero protrusion), Hettich, GRASS
zawiasy/ukryty: Invisible hinge — recessed into the door thickness

The hinge is hidden within the thickness of the door and cabinet side: neither the cup nor the arm is visible with the door closed or open. Salice Conecta is fully concealed and soft-closing (for wooden doors); Salice Air is approx. 10 mm and works with doors in Salice aluminium frames.
zawiasy/kieszeniowy: Pocket door hinge (front slides into the side of the cabinet)
After opening, the door slides on runners into a side pocket of the cabinet and takes up no space in front of the unit. Ideal for hidden kitchens, bars, appliance “garages” or a built-in TV.
Blum (REVEGO), Häfele / HAWA (Concepta, Folding Concepta), Hettich
bez-uchwytow/nacisniecie: A light push on the front releases a mechanism that pushes the door or drawer open — no electricity and no handle.
bez-uchwytow/elektryczne: A small motor opens the drawer or lift after a light touch on the front, and it closes with soft-close. Also used for integrated fridges and dishwashers.
bez-uchwytow/gola: An aluminium finger recess running along the fronts replaces handles — horizontally or vertically. The front is gripped from above or from the side, and the cabinetry stays smooth.
szuflady/cienkoscienne: Modern drawers with very thin, straight metal sides. A light look, full extension and soft-close.
Blum (LEGRABOX), GTV (Axis Pro), Hettich (AvanTech YOU), GRASS (Vionaro)
szuflady/standardowe: Classic metal drawers with a thicker, double-walled side — a proven solution at a better price, in several heights and colours.
Blum (TANDEMBOX), GTV (Modern Box), Hettich (InnoTech), GRASS (Nova Pro Scala)
szuflady/wysokie: Tall pull-outs for pots, bottles and supplies: the thin side is raised with a gallery rail or a glass or metal panel that keeps the contents in place.
Blum (LEGRABOX — high sides, gallery rails), GTV (Axis Pro Glass), Hettich
szuflady-opcje/tip-on: A handle-free drawer opens when the front is pushed. TIP-ON BLUMOTION combines push-to-open with soft-close; the electric version is SERVO-DRIVE.
Blum (TIP-ON, TIP-ON BLUMOTION), Hettich (Push to open Silent), GRASS
szuflady-opcje/cichy-domyk: A damper in the runner slows the drawer down at the end of its travel and pulls it shut — silently, even when pushed hard or heavily loaded.
szuflady-opcje/wyposazenie: Low, medium and tall drawers as well as inner drawers hidden behind doors. Inserts for cutlery, knives, spices and plates and dividers for pots and lids keep the interior organised.
szuflady-opcje/sztucce: An insert with compartments matched to the drawer width — cutlery and small utensils have fixed places; versions for shallow and wide drawers.
szuflady-opcje/noze: An insert with slots for knives fitted in a drawer — the blades are safe and take up no worktop space.
szuflady-opcje/przyprawy-talerze: Inserts for plates, spices and foil
A plate holder with movable pegs (plates in a drawer instead of a wall cabinet), a spice insert and a dispenser for foil and baking paper.
szuflady-opcje/syfon: A U-shaped drawer goes around the siphon and pipes under the sink or washbasin, so the whole sink cabinet is usable and opens like a normal drawer.
podnosniki/mala-klapa: Small stay lift (e.g. above the fridge)
A small front swings upwards on a fitting mounted at the top of the cabinet. The compact fitting fits even shallow cabinets, e.g. above the cooker hood.
podnosniki/klapa: The front swings upwards and stops in any position; it needs little space above the cabinet.
Blum (AVENTOS HK top), Hettich (Lift Advanced HK), GRASS (Kinvaro T-Slim)
podnosniki/nad-szafke: A large, one-piece front rises in an arc above the cabinet and does not obstruct the interior.
podnosniki/pionowy: The front travels straight upwards. A good choice with a low ceiling or above a worktop with appliances.
Blum (AVENTOS HL), Hettich (Lift Advanced HL), GRASS (Kinvaro L-80)
podnosniki/skladany: A two-part front folds in the middle and rises upwards — for tall wall cabinets.
Blum (AVENTOS HF), Hettich (Lift Advanced HF), GRASS (Kinvaro F-20)
cargo/cargo-waskie: A narrow pull-out with baskets for bottles, spices and oils — it makes use of leftover space in the cabinetry.
cargo/cargo-wysokie: The entire contents of a tall cabinet slide out together with the front; the railed shelves are accessible from both sides.
cargo/tandem: Larder with baskets that come out with the door
When the door opens, the baskets mounted on the door and the baskets inside slide forward together.
cargo/space-tower: A tall cabinet with doors, behind which are full-extension drawers — each opens separately, with access to the contents from above and from the sides.
cargo/odpady: Pull-out recycling bins in the sink cabinet, with soft-close; optionally opened with a knee or a touch.
cargo/reczniki: A narrow pull-out with bars for tea towels and kitchen towels, fitted in a base cabinet or a gap of approx. 15 cm — towels dry out of sight.
narozniki/lemans: Rounded shelves glide out of the corner one after the other, giving access to all the contents.
narozniki/magic-corner: When the door opens, the front baskets slide out of the cabinet and the rear ones move forward from the depth of the corner.
narozniki/karuzela: Rotating shelves in an L-shaped corner — the contents come to the door when the shelf is turned.
cokoly/szuflada-cokol: A flat drawer in place of the plinth for baking trays, towels or pet food; usually handle-free with push-to-open.
Blum, Hettich, GTV; ready-made plinth drawers from various manufacturers
cokoly/stopien: The step slides out of the plinth with a light touch (load capacity up to 150 kg) and makes it easier to reach wall cabinets; there is storage underneath.
windy/kosz-opuszczany: Pull-down basket in a wall cabinet (manual or electric)
A basket with shelves comes out of the wall cabinet and lowers to hand height — mechanically on a spring or with a motor.
windy/winda-agd: A shelf holding a heavy appliance, e.g. a stand mixer, comes out of the base cabinet and rises to worktop height.
windy/tv: The TV hides in a sideboard or bench (e.g. at the foot of the bed) and rises electrically at the press of a remote.
windy/stol: Pull-out table / worktop from a cabinet
A table top slides out in place of a drawer or from a cabinet — extra space for eating and working that disappears after use.
gniazdka/gniazdo-blat: A tower with sockets and USB hides in the worktop and rises manually or by motor; when retracted only the cover is visible.
gniazdka/gniazdo-szuflada: Socket in a drawer / under a wall cabinet
Charging phones and small appliances inside a drawer or from a strip under a wall cabinet — no cables on the worktop.
Docking Drawer; under-cabinet power strips from various manufacturers
gniazdka/qi: Wireless charger in / under the worktop
Your phone charges as soon as you put it on the worktop: a charger mounted underneath works through stone or sintered stone up to approx. 25 mm; there are also versions built into a socket cover.
gniazdka/lazienka-gniazdo: Pull-out bathroom organiser with a socket
A narrow pull-out in a bathroom cabinet with a power socket and holders for a hairdryer, straightener or shaver — the devices stay plugged in and the cables hidden.
led/profile-led: LED profiles under cabinets and in furniture
LED strips in surface-mounted and recessed aluminium profiles light the worktop, shelves and display cabinets.
led/led-czujnik: The light switches on by itself when a drawer or door opens and turns off when it closes.
garderoba/pantograf: Pull-down wardrobe rail (pantograph) — manual or electric
The rail in a tall wardrobe comes down to hand height; available in manual, electric and LED-lit versions.
garderoba/drazek-wysuwany: A short rod on a runner fitted in the wardrobe at right angles to the front; it slides forward to lay out clothes for the next day or hang things up for a moment.
Häfele, Rev-A-Shelf, wardrobe systems from various manufacturers
garderoba/spodniarka: A frame with a row of bars on full-extension runners — trousers hang flat, don't crease, and every pair is visible when pulled out.
garderoba/krawaty-paski: A narrow pull-out with hooks or compartments for ties, belts and scarves, mounted on the side of the wardrobe or under a shelf.
garderoba/wklady-garderoba: Drawer inserts: jewellery, glasses, watches, socks
Inserts with compartments (often velour-lined) divide the drawer into sections for jewellery, glasses, cufflinks, watches, socks or underwear; some are two-tier with a sliding tray.
Häfele, Peka, Closet Factory and wardrobe system manufacturers
garderoba/buty-wysuwane: Shoe shelves or frames on full-extension runners — every pair is visible at once, even in a deep wardrobe.
garderoba/buty-obrotowe: A rotating column of shoe shelves fitted in the wardrobe: turn it and each pair comes to the door — a narrow wardrobe holds plenty of shoes.
garderoba/kosz-pranie: A basket or bag for dirty laundry on runners — pull-out or tilt-out — hidden in a wardrobe, walk-in closet or bathroom cabinet.
garderoba/deska: Ironing board hidden in a drawer
A full-size ironing board that unfolds from a drawer or from behind a front; after use it folds away and disappears into the furniture.
garderoba/lustro: A mirror hidden in the wardrobe slides out and swivels, then disappears back inside after use.
garderoba/witryna: Wardrobe with glass doors (display in a walk-in closet)
Glass doors in aluminium frames with interior lighting — clothes, bags or shoes are on display as in a boutique and protected from dust at the same time.
Aluminium frames for glass fronts from various manufacturers + LED lighting
garderoba/led-garderoba: A rail with a built-in LED strip or light profiles along the wardrobe sides, switched on by a motion or door sensor — clothes are clearly visible in every corner.
drzwi/przesuwne: The doors run on a top or bottom track and need no space in front of the wardrobe.
drzwi/harmonijka: The leaves fold up as they open and reveal almost the full width of the wardrobe.
drzwi/kieszen: Tall door leaves open and slide into side pockets of the cabinetry — an extension of the pocket system from the “Hinges” group.
sprytne/kosz-elektryczny: Electric pull-down basket for a wall cabinet
The basket lowers from the wall cabinet by motor at the touch of a button. Popular in China; according to one listing it cannot be lowered by hand during a power cut.
Unbranded offers (China), e.g. NUOMI — CE compliance to be checked
sprytne/gniazdo-qi: Motorised pop-up worktop socket + Qi charger
The socket tower rises by itself after a touch, and the lid charges your phone wirelessly.
Unbranded products and distributors (e.g. Simple Lighting, BOX15) — compliance with local standards to be checked
sprytne/gniazda-szynowe: A rail mounted on the wall into which sockets can be clipped and moved anywhere. In the kitchen only grease- and water-resistant versions.
sprytne/garaz-agd: A recess on the worktop closed with a roller shutter, a flap or a pocket front — the kettle, coffee machine and toaster disappear from view.
Joinery solution + fittings (e.g. AVENTOS HL, REVEGO)
sprytne/sejf: The drawer opens only when a finger is placed on the reader; from the outside only the reader is visible.
sprytne/roomspin: A rotating and swivelling fitting that lets a piece of furniture change its function, e.g. a desk turns into a shelf unit — for small flats and multi-purpose rooms.
